## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Tech leadership XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND and falling fear VXX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) BELOW TREND, plus SPY/TLT ↑ rising confirm stocks over bonds.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) BELOW TREND and Stocks vs Bonds SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND / TLT (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND show risk-on internals. Credit mixed: HYG (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +2.07%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +1.64%) ABOVE TREND but credit spread reading flat (↑ subtle).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing: Dollar (Level) 27.36 (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -0.80%) BELOW TREND and Yield curve RECOVERY (↑ flat) with TLT (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +0.53%) ABOVE TREND providing modest ballast.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Technology leading: XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND and semis SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND are top drivers; Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/Momentum leadership confirmed by XLK strength and broad sector breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US strong: SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND; EM/Emerging strength: EEM (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +10.56%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +3.87%) ABOVE TREND outperform Europe (Europe vs US ↓ falling | CORRECTION).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation elevated: ARKK (1W: +14.35% | 1M: +10.95%) ABOVE TREND, IBIT (1W: +5.73% | 1M: +9.14%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +5.54% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND show retail/alpha chase.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial metals strong: CPER (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND while Gold GLD (1W: +2.01% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND is holding safe-haven interest amid risk-on.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy remains weak: XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND and Brent BNO (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%) BELOW TREND, while NatGas UNG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -14.44%) RECOVERY shows short-term bounce only.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad equity leadership—SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%), QQQ (1W: +6.18% | 1M: +9.21%), XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) all ABOVE TREND. MINOR divergences: XLB (CORRECTION) and UNG (RECOVERY) flagged but no MAJOR core-ETF divergence.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum exposures such as XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND and monitor credit LQD (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +1.64%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND and Utilities (sector breadth -1.32% | -1.47%) showing weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND on industrial demand signals. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -12.83%) BELOW TREND as oil continues to correct.

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX ~20 as a complacency pivot (VXX today 28.98 ↓ falling | BELOW TREND), HYG/LQD ~0.80 for credit health (HYG 1W: +0.86% | 1M: +2.07% ABOVE TREND; LQD 1W: +0.77% | 1M: +1.64% ABOVE TREND), and XLK/market leadership gap for momentum fade (XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and VXX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -16.44%) BELOW TREND with SPY (1W: +4.52% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND confirm equities leadership. Technology and semiconductors (XLK (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.02%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +22.89%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength while Energy XLE (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -5.22%) BELOW TREND is the key area of weakness to monitor.
